blocks.text: Student Learning Outcomes (is chapter mein kya seekhenge)
Is chapter ke aakhir tak aap yeh kar sakenge:

items: Yeh jaanch (evaluate) sakenge ke mukhtalif stakeholders (woh log ya idare jin par asar parta hai) ki saqafat (culture), aqdar (values) aur kabhi kabhi takrane wale mafadat (conflicting interests) AI systems ke design par kaise asar dalte hain, aur aisi policies (qawaid) ka jaiza le sakenge jo stakeholders ke mafadat ki hifazat karti hain.

Emerging technologies (nayi ubharti technologies) jaise Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT), Cloud Computing aur Blockchain use kar ke Pakistan ke liye nayi (innovative) applications design kar sakenge.

blocks.text: Is chapter mein talaba emerging technologies (nayi ubharti technologies) ke zariye computer science ke istemal dekhenge. Woh Artificial Intelligence (AI) aur rozmarra applications mein is ka istemal seekhenge, jaise voice assistants, chatbots aur image recognition (tasveer pehchanna), aur saath is ke fawaid aur challenges bhi. Chapter Internet of Things (IoT) ka taaruf karata hai aur batata hai ke jure hue devices automation (khud-kaar kaam) ke liye data kaise jama aur share karte hain. Chapter AI ke cultural (saqafati) aur ethical (akhlaqi) asraat bhi samjhata hai, jaise insaf, transparency (shaffafiyat) aur mukhtalif stakeholders (mutasir logon aur idaron) ka kirdar. Talaba dekhenge ke emerging technologies Pakistan ke qaumi masail hal karne mein kaise kaam aa sakti hain, khaas tor par smart agriculture (smart zaraat) jaise naye hal. Aakhir mein woh policies, regulations (qawaid) aur responsible innovation (zimmedarana nayi ijaad) seekhenge, aur yeh ke technology ka akhlaqi aur paidar (sustainable) istemal kyun zaroori hai.

blocks.prompt: Is chapter mein kaun si chaar emerging technologies parhi jayengi, aur chapter ke aakhir mein kis baat par zor diya gaya hai?
blocks.explanation: AI, IoT, Cloud Computing aur Blockchain. Aakhir mein policies, regulations (qawaid) aur responsible innovation (zimmedarana nayi ijaad) par zor hai, yani technology ka akhlaqi (ethical) aur paidar (sustainable) istemal.

items: Chapter: AI, IoT, Cloud aur Blockchain ke istemal, fawaid aur challenges.
AI ke saqafati aur akhlaqi pehlu, Pakistan ke masail ke liye applications (smart agriculture), aur policies.
